english.title: Postal service - send record of obscene / indecent picture / book / card etc
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) sent by post a postal packet enclosing a

(A)_[a record of an indecent or obscene picture, namely **(..SPECIFY PICTURE..)]_
(B)_[a record of indecent or obscene pictures, namely **(..SPECIFY PICTURES..)]_
(C)_[a record of an indecent or obscene book, namely **(..SPECIFY BOOK..)]_
(D)_[a record of indecent or obscene books, namely **(..SPECIFY BOOKS..)]_
(E)_[a record of an indecent or obscene card, namely **(..SPECIFY CARD..)]_
(F)_[a record of indecent or obscene cards, namely **(..SPECIFY CARDS..)]_
(G)_[a record of an indecent or obscene written communication, namely **(..SPECIFY COMMUNICATION..)]_
(H)_[a record of indecent or obscene written communications, namely **(..SPECIFY COMMUNICATIONS..)]_
(I)_[free text for use where more than one of the above options is identified]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 85(3) and (5) of the Postal Services Act 2000.

investigatoraction.description: Consider an application for a sexual harm prevention order after conviction
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Twelve months imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
